nom: d'Alba Piedmont White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum

avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion. I really like d'Alba products and I had high expectations from this serum. It didn't disappoint. I really like how hydrating the serum is. I felt my skin stays a bit oily throughout the day even with little product and my skin is on the dryer side. I don't mind the feeling but it might not work for oily skin people. It has a slight fragrance to it which doesn't linger and I like it. Overall its a good product.

I've been using this serum for about a month now and I would happily restock it. Lightweight but nourishing, this serum absorbs quickly and leaves a natural, dewy glow without feeling greasy. My skin felt smoother and more hydrated after a few uses, with no irritation. Just make sure to shake well before applying. I received this product as a free sample in exchange for my honest review.

The biggest thing I noticed is the glow. My skin looks more dewy and smooth almost immediately after applying. It's especially good under makeup. It gives that "glass skin" look without needing a ton of highlighter. I like that I can wear it during the day and just put my makeup on top without feeling heavy.

avis.titre: Amazing glowy serum you want in your skin care routine.
avis.texte: d'Alba kindly sent my this product for free to review. With age, you can begin to experience dry and rough skin and I had been on the hunt to change up my skin care routine to address this issue. Cue d'Alba and their amazing serum. I use this in the morning and evening after washing my face and after using their double serum and cream. This truffle serum helps lock in the hydration from the cream, smooths out your skin, and provides the best glow finish. Although it is an oil, it does not leave your skin a sticky-oily mess, and your pillow case is safe from oily stains. Highly recommend this serum as a final step to your skin care routine.

avis.titre: d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum
avis.texte: Absolutely love d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum! Facial skin looks and feels amazing with a beautiful, healthy glow. Really appreciate the natural ingredients for provide long-lasting moisture. Also great to be dermatologically tested, hypoallergenic, and suitable for all skin types. Nice and pleasant fragrance to enjoy, as well!

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Serum for about a month, and I'm really pleased with the results. My skin feels more hydrated, firmer, and has a healthy glow. The serum is lightweight, absorb quickly, and don't leave any sticky residue. It also smell amazing! This serum has been a great addition to my skincare routine—I'd definitely recommend it to my family and would happily repurchase.
I really enjoy using this. It smells great and makes my skin glow. It doesn't irritate my skin at all. I can feel a change in my skin already. My face is more moisturized and looks great after use.

I love the serum spray from this brand, and this serum is also amazing. I love shaking it up to emulsify the two layers every time I use it, and this leaves my skin with the prettiest glow. It's a very hydrating serum and I've found that my skin has definitely looked more glowy after using this. It doesn't do anything miraculous, but I love using this as an everyday hydration serum!
When you apply this serum you can automatically feel it working. I face feels fresh and I feel really good using this serum. My face looks better and I like the way it feels when I use it.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. My skin felt so refreshed after using this product. I used in morning and evening and after about one week I could feel a difference and soon after I could see the affects. Love this serum.

avis.titre: Glowy, Hydrated Skin in One Simple Step
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum, especially compared to other serums I've tried that either feel too heavy or don't deliver lasting hydration. The dual-layer formula gives it a unique texture, and once shaken, it absorbs nicely without leaving a greasy residue while still giving my skin a noticeable glow. I love that it's packed with antioxidants and nourishing oils, which makes my skin feel smoother and more hydrated throughout the day and night. It also feels gentle and didn't cause any irritation, which is a big plus for daily use. One of the biggest benefits is how it simplifies my routine since it combines hydration and glow in one step. I would definitely buy this again and would recommend it to friends or family looking for a lightweight but effective serum.

This serum is feels very luxurious. I found it silky on the skin and added some plumpness and hydration upon application. I haven't noticed any further benefits from it as far as skin condition besides hydration but I will continue to use it.
I was instantly sold on this product after the first use. It made my skin look and feel great. Wore well under other skincare and makeup.

I received the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum for free in exchange for my honest opinion. My skin can get super dry, especially during the winter months. This serum is a amazing for treating that dry, flaky skin. It doesn't just hydrate; it also provides beneficial oils my skin needs to maintain its barrier. What I love about this serum is that it's not only effective but also fun to use. I love mixing up the layers. The scent is very pleasant, and the sleek glass bottle with the gold pump is luxurious feeling.
My skin does have a noticeable difference after layering this product with the dual moisturizer. Skin feels smoother as well. It is a bit strange getting used to a product that goes on tacky though.

avis.titre: Perfect for my spots in my face
avis.texte: Perfect for my spots in my face. It keeps my face looking brighter the more I use it. I am so happy my dark spots are disappearing.
This serum is really good it has firming effect and it also provides Radiance to ur skin. I love how my skin feels when I put this on , very plump and smooth. It's very hydrating and soothing.

d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum feels super luxurious but surprisingly lightweight once you shake it and apply and I love that it absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy finish. My skin instantly looks more radiant and hydrated, and gives that subtle "glass skin" glow. The white truffle ingredient is also an amazing added touch that I never expected. It layers beautifully under makeup and hasn't caused any breakouts or irritation, which is a huge plus for me. The scent is light and fresh—nothing overpowering!

avis.titre: I will keep using this daily. Love it!
avis.texte: First off I want to say thank you to D'Alba for this free sample through BZzzAgent. I have been trying lots of products for my aging skin, and I have to say, I really enjoyed using d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum. It was refreshing but light and made my skin feel silky, not sticky, greasy, or dry. It says 2-3 pumps but I found I needed 3 to cover my neck as well. The serum is great by itself but works best with the cream. It's my new favorite moisturizer.

avis.titre: Makes skin soft, but feels a little heavy.
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. After cleansing, I applied the serum. At first, it made my skin feel a little tacky but absorbed shortly after. I can still feel the serum on my face but it wasn't bothersome. It feels a little thicker than my usual serum. My skin did look like it was somewhat glowing after a week of use. I haven't noticed any other big difference in my skin, but it has only been a week. I'm not sure if I would purchase this. I do have other serums that absorb completely to the point of not knowing I have anything on my face.

D'alba serum has a soft and hydrating consistency. The formula is like no other. It makes my skin feel extra firm and the product is vegan. They even go as far as doing an irritation test which makes it a great option for sensitive skin.

My first time trying this serum and I'm very impressed. It's lightweight and absorbs well, very hydrating. After using it, my skin feels so soft and smooth! I usually use it as a part of my night time skincare routine.

I am in my mid 30's with combination skin and love using this serum to help my skin feel refreshed, hydrating, healthy and glowy! It's very easy to use, shake so that the serum and oil mix, and apply a few pumps to the face and decolletage. The smell is subtle and lovely, and calming, nothing overly scented. It provides excellent hydration so I primarily use it in the evening when I like to incorporate oils and heavier creams. A little goes a long way so it's also a very good value.

avis.titre: I'm eager to explore more of this Korean skincare line!
avis.texte: d'Alba piedmont Double Layer Revitalizing Serum White Trufflr was such a unique product to test out. The secret to this ultra hydrating serum is the 30% oil,ci found it rich and absorbent without leaving any messy residue. My skin completely absorbs every drop, in my mid 30s my skincare routine consistently looks for hydrating serums abd I found this gem. I'm going to be repurchasing this serum and looking forward to test the rest of their skincare line.
I love how you have to shake it up. I use this as a first step of morning skincare. It's very easy to apply and has a light texture. It gives my skin a glow.

I've used this product consistently for a couple of weeks and love it so far. I have dry skin and notice a glowing difference when I apply it in the morning. I love the scent and packaging. Will continue using.

avis.titre: This is a product I will add to my facial outine.
avis.texte: This product is light and is not oily or sticky. It hydrates and absorbs easily into the skin. When I applied the serum, it felt like I was applying water and it absorbed quickly. My face felt nice, silky and smooth to the touch. It also has a nice scent that is not too strong. The pump bottle is perfect as it is easy to use and prevents a mess.
You definitely need to shake this product up. It leaves your skin feeling hydrated and glossy. The scent is clean and refreshing

This has been the first step in my routine after washing my face in the mornings. It is a very thin almost water like texture that does feel sticky as you are applying but the stickiness goes away and you are left with a smooth glowy finish. Personally I am not a huge fan of the smell, it would be better unscented but it does not have a bad smell. I like how it sits under makeup and would consider buying it again for an extra glow.
I love that it absorbs quickly and leaves face feeling hydrated all day.

I've been using this serum for couple days. Every time I applied it on my face, I can see that my skin was glowing. Love the texture and light aroma of the serum. I am thinking to buy another bottle when this one is out.

This serum has been a great addition to my routine, especially as my skin has become more dry over the years. I appreciate products that deliver both hydration and radiance, this one does both and more. It feels lightweight and leaves my skin feeling refreshed instantly. It absorbs quickly, which I appreciate because I don't have the patience for sticky products anymore. Since I started using it, my skin looks more even and less tired, which is a big win for me. The hydration lasts through the day, which is something I really need now. I also love how fresh and clean it feels on my skin. This serum has earned a permanent spot in my routine. I highly recommend it.

I was a little worried that this bi-phase serum would make my skin feel oily but it's surprising lightweight for a product that has a 30% oil layer. I have drier skin, especially in the colder months, it also can look dull (probably due to it being dehydrated) and this did a good job of adding hydration and giving my skin a healthy glow. It absorbs into my skin with little effort and hasn't made any makeup I wear over it pill or separate. I do find that a little goes a long way, so the bottle will last a decent amount of time. It has a light, pleasant fragrance, similar to what I imagine a high end spa would smell like. I don't usually like fragrance in my skincare but this isn't a perfumey scent, it's a natural botanical scent. It doesn't last long which I can see being a big plus for anyone who isn't a fan of any scent in their serums. Depending on your skin type, you may be able to get away with just using this, instead of a serum, oil and light lotion. I know once the warmer weather comes this will be enough for my skin. Overall, I'm pleased with the product and not only would I recommend it but I would definitely purchase it again. *I received this product for free, for testing & review purposes, in exchange for my honest review*

I received this product and have used it everyday for the past week. I really like the texture of this and the scent is lightly citrusy which I absolutely love. It leaves my skin feeling really nice and smooth with no oily residue.

It was luxurious experience to try this brand. The serum got rid of the stubborn dry patches on my face. It gave me enough moisture for dry winter weather and I've never had the glow on my skin before using this serum. Also it smells high end without the price. Very satisfied.
This serum sinks into my skin and doesn't leave my face feeling tacky or slick. The fragrance is not over powering. It leaves my skin looking healthy and moisturized.

avis.titre: Obsessed with the glow this gives my skin!
avis.texte: I've been using this serum consistently, twice a day and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. The texture is lightweight yet deeply hydrating, and it absorbs beautifully without leaving any sticky residue. My skin looks noticeably more radiant, smooth, and healthy after each use.

I really liked how light it felt on my skin. I layered it on under my other skincare routine and I felt that it was a natural addition to my routine. It made my skin feel super soft and smooth. this was a great product.
This serum is amazing. I love that it smells great, is so easy to use and leaves my skin feeling amazing. The packaging is high end. I would definitely buy this again!

This serum has a light, pleasant scent and absorbs very quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky feeling. This serum has a very watery consistency, you need to shake it well before use and pump it quickly, otherwise it separates again. It provides good hydration, and my skin looks more plump, smooth, and glowy after using it. I also like applying it before makeup because it helps create a smoother base for foundation. It works well for my combination skin.
Been using it for almost a month. My skin feels so much softer since. The smell is pleasant. Item was given for review.

This was my first time using a d'Alba product and I really enjoyed the Double Layer Revitalizing Serum. I admit I am terrible at remembering to shake products before using so the fact this was in a clear bottle and there is a visualization of the two products separating and needing to be shook was really helpful. I used about two pumps both morning and evening before my moisturizer and I loved the silkiness on my skin. As for the results, I did notice a visual difference in the smoothness of my skin texture and decrease in redness. For the price of a bottle, this is one I will pick up again
Easy to apply and is very moisturizing. Great scent and firms my skin wonderfully.

avis.titre: A Gentle Glow, Not a Miracle Serum
avis.texte: I received this product through BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review. The d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum has a light, fresh scent. I was expecting something earthy or heavy because of the truffle, but it's actually really pleasant. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly, which feels nice on the skin. That said, I didn't notice any dramatic results. It adds hydration and a subtle glow, but it's not a miracle worker. So while it's a nice-feeling, elegant product, it's more of a gentle boost than a transformative serum. Overall, it's easy to use, smells lovely, and makes for a pleasant addition to a skincare routine, but if you're hoping for major changes, you might want to keep your expectations realistic.
Get double the benefits with this double serum. Shake well and easily apply to your face and keep doing it consistently so you can start seeing your skin revitalized

I loved this serum right from the start. I've used it daily for about a week and I love the way it gives an ever-so-subtle glow, but layers perfectly under my moisturizer. It soaks in pretty quickly, too!

avis.titre: Lovely formulation that leaves a glow!
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I'm really impressed with this serum's formulation. It's great that it's certified vegan, and I love the nourishing ingredients like vitamin E, avocado oil, and sunflower seed oil. My skin wakes up with a subtle, non-greasy glow and looks a little brighter. The pump dispenser is convenient, and the texture spreads effortlessly. No tugging required. It's watery enough to glide on but not so thin that it runs, so application is easy. The scent is light and pleasant, and the bottle has a luxe feel. I've had no issues layering it over other skincare either. Overall I recommend it!

I continue to be impressed by everything I try from d'Alba! This serum is exceptional. It feels lovely on application and absorbs into your skin like a dream. I feel like lately when I look in the mirror my skin has been dull and less firm—and ever since I started using this serum, I've noticed a significant difference. Truly in love and will repurchase forever!
Feels and smells great. Makes skin tight and shiny. Not too oily.

avis.titre: Glowy, hydrated skin in a bottle
avis.texte: I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum consistently and I honestly love how lightweight but hydrating it feels on my skin. The first thing I noticed was how it gives my skin that instant glow without feeling heavy or greasy. Compared to other serums I've tried, this one layers really well into my routine and doesn't pill which is a big deal for me. It leaves my skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed, especially in the mornings. I also love that it gives that healthy skin look instead of just sitting on top of the skin. Over time, I've noticed my skin looking more hydrated and balanced. One thing I will say is that you do need to shake it before using because of the double layer, but that's super quick and easy. Overall, I would definitely continue using this in my routine and I would recommend it to anyone looking for a glow boosting, hydrating serum that feels lightweight but effective. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I use this every night and love the feeling it leaves on my skin. I've noticed fine lines disappearing and my skin has it an elasticity and bounce back. As a 45 year old woman, this is liquid gold!! I will definitely be purchasing this product
Great serum for under makeup very hydrating and lightweight did not have any kind of reaction to it, and I felt that it helped with any dry patches that I had immediately it was absorbed to the skin

avis.titre: A serum that leaves skin fresh and radiant
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum has a very interesting two-phase formula with a 30% glowing oil layer and a 70% elastic serum layer, so you need to shake it well before each use to mix everything together. Once applied, it feels light and smooth on the skin. It spreads gently, absorbs quickly, and does not leave my face feeling heavy or greasy. It gives my skin nice hydration and a healthy glow without causing irritation or clogged pores. I also like that it feels nourishing while still being comfortable to use in a regular skincare routine.

This is a richer serum than I'm used to using currently, and I really like it. It absorbs well despite the "oil" appearance. My dry/dehydrated skin benefits from the dual texture (shake it up before applying) and feels moisturized and glowy.

This is the first time I used a K skincare product and I have to say that I am impressed. This product is easy to use. You just shake it and pump it then apply it to entire face except the eyes. When I looked at the product it looked oily but once you apply it to face, it goes on thinly and dissolves quickly as you rub it in. There is no scent and my face felt smooth and moisturized. A nice product overall and well worth the price.
This serum absorbs into skin nicely without leaving any sticky feeling. Very hydrating and leaves my skin looking great! It does have a light fragrance but it'a not overpowering at all.

Loved this serum. It was gentle but super moisturizing. I sometimes get sensitive to new products but my skin did just fine with adding this to my routine. Definitely recommend and will continue on using. I look so hydrated in the mornings!

I like how the bottle feels heavy and luxurious! I use this serum after I double cleanse my face, I leave it on for about 10 minutes so the product has time to soak in the skin. Then I apply moisturizer over it! It leaves my skin with a nice radiance :) thank you to D'Alba for the free sample!

After you wash your face using the d'Alba double layer serum is a must. It feels so nice on the face it has a cooling refreshing feel on my skin and it has my face feeling moisturized and fresh, I absolutely love this serum. Will definitely buy again
Love this formula, super luxurious feeling. Not too heavy or greasy at all on my oily/combo skin. Helps even out skin tone

I've been using the d'Alba Double Layer Revitalizing Serum and I am really enjoying it. It has this really lightweight, slightly nourishing texture that just melts into my skin. It makes my skin feel soft and hydrated right away, but what I love most is the glow! It's there, but it's subtle. Not greasy or shiny like a lot of glowy serums make me look afterwards. I also feel like it layers really well with the rest of my routine and sits beautifully under makeup. It gives my skin that smooth, prepped feeling without feeling heavy. Overall, it's effective, and makes my skin look like a better version of itself!

What I like about the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum is that it gives you a nice glow. It feels luxurious and it is lightweight. It has a non-greasy finish. I wish the scent wasn't so strong though.

avis.titre: A Easy Way to Great Looking Skin.
avis.texte: I have received this product in exchange for my honest review. All in all this serum has proved to be beneficial for my facial skin. I shook up the bottle to mix the oil and serum up. I applied the serum to my face and it absorbed quickly into my skin. I experience slightly irritated skin but that only lasted for a few minutes. My forehead appeared a little oily at first but that went away after a little time. I have been left with low key dewy and glowy skin. My skin is soft, smooth,hydrated and healthy looking. The scent was mild and I did not really like it but that did dissipate after a while.
I love how amazing this made the texture of my skin and just my skin look and feel, I've been getting so many compliments on how flawless it looks

This is a great serum that helps keep my face looking dewy and soft for the majority of my day. I shake the bottle vigorously and create the emulsion within the bottle, pump two dabs into a cotton ball then apply it to my face. I follow up with a moisturizer

I'm a flight attendant flirting with 50, so my skin is mature and spending most of my days on airplanes and in hotel rooms dries my skin out. I was excited that d'Alba kindly gave me this White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum for free so that I could review it. I tested it daily for two weeks before this review. I used it with makeup and found that it doesn't cause foundation to crease or pill and everything stays in place. This serum gives my skin an extra boost of hydration and works really well on my neck. I haven't had any breakouts and leaves my skin very soft and not sticky. I feel that it works best with a moisturizer on top; using it alone isn't enough. At my age, an extra shot of hydration is necessary. I'll definitely continue to use this and other d'Alba products because Korean skincare is top shelf!

This is a highly moisturizing serum formulated with a 3:7 ratio of oil to serum. I used it in the morning, after my toner and before my cream. A slightly dewy finish, but no sticky feel. It paired well with my other skincare products. It has a fresh and citrusy scent. Since it offers excellent moisturizing power, I think people with dry skin will really like it.

I've really been enjoying these products. They feel lightweight and comfortable on the skin, but still give a nice boost of hydration. My skin feels noticeably smoother and softer after using them, with a healthy, refreshed look. They layer well into my routine and don't feel heavy or greasy, which I appreciate. Overall, they've been a great addition for keeping my skin feeling balanced and looking more radiant.
I received this product for my honest review. I love this serum I makes ur skin so soft and smooth. Very glowy highdrated and perfect for daily use .
My skin has never looked and felt so good since using d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum

avis.titre: A new holy grail for hydration
avis.texte: I'm in love with this serum! The fragrance is amazing and it quickly absorbs into my skin. It feels like my skin just got a drink of water - very moisturizing and hydrating. You definitely need to shake prior to dispensing. I'll definitely be keeping this in my morning and evening skincare routines. Bonus that I love the golden pearlescent color. However it's invisible once applied. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I really liked the smell it gives and usually whatever the serum I tried it gives dry or minimal glowy look. But When I tried this it really surprised me especially when I am using with moisturizer together. I will definitely buying it for my skin care routine!

avis.titre: Does not irritate my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I love the d'Alba brand and recently added the Double Layer Revitalizing Serum to my skincare regimen, and what a difference in my skin! I am using this in the morning and evening on my freshly washed (and toned) face, neck and upper chest. The results were noticeable right away, my skin looks and feels smoother. My neck feels tighter, and I can feel it working! I love the quality of ingredients; the white truffles are sourced from Italy. The best part is I can use this amazing youth-restoring serum without any irritation to my super sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Silky smooth serum for glass skin
avis.texte: The serum has a silky and very thin consistency that easily glides across your face. It's absorbed quickly, no sticky residue, and you immediately feel the hydrating and glowing effects. I would continue to use this as a lightweight serum with many moisturizing benefits for my mixed oily/ dry skin. I was worried there would be a strong fragrance associated with 'white truffle' but the scent was actually very pleasant and neutral.

I used day and night because it was... easy. Sometimes I get a serum and stray away from it slowly... just using it at night because it's oilier or sits on top of my skin. And then I start skipping nights because it feels heavier. This one? Not for a minute - it absorbed so nicely into my skin, making it easier to do the best thing for my skin - use the product!

I love d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalization Serum, it goes on leaving my face feeling silky smooth and radiant. No redness, no burning feeling, or breakouts have occurred. The smell is refreshing. Definitely recommend.
This serum is hydrating but too shiny on my skin. I personally don't like that much of a shiny effect on my face. The smell is not overwhelming. Does have a yellow tint to it.
This serum made my skin look brighter. It's not too heavy, and a little goes a long way. I have spent so much money on serums, and I can truly say this one is one of my top favorites now!

I've used the Revitalizing Serum for a few weeks now, and it's become a staple in my routine. Its super lightweight yet nourishing and rich, leaving skin hydrated with a noticeable glow. It absorbs well, not greasy, and easy to apply. A great option if you're looking for a hydrating serum that delivers both instant and long-term results.

I got this product for free in exchange for a review. I was super excited because I had been wanting to try it. The scent is super light but smells good. The product hydrates my skin and leaves it feeling smooth. I get oily pretty quickly so I thought this would increase the oil but it doesn't. I feel like it gives it the moisture it needs and smooths it out without adding oil to it. I would definitely buy this in the future.

The packaging is great and the serum smells lovely but it was way too overbearing for me. The serum consistency felt too sticky personally. I didn't feel moisturized or clean after applying the product. I wouldn't recommend this product unfortunately.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Thanks d'Alba for the free White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum. This serum leaves my skin hydrated without feeling oily. Absorbs quickly to the skin and is great to use as a hydrating base under makeup, also has a nice light luxurious scent. I've also used this serum at night paired with the Double Serum & Cream and I wake up with hydrated and smooth skin. Would highly recommend.

avis.titre: Lightweight Glow Without the Greasy Feel
avis.texte: Ive been using the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum for a few weeks and ended up liking it more than I expected. You do have to shake it to mix the layers, but it absorbs quickly and doesn't feel greasy. It gives my skin a nice glow and keeps it feeling hydrated throughout the day. It also sits well under moisturizer and makeup, which I appreciate. I was a little hesitant because of the oil, but it hasn't caused any breakouts. A bit pricey, but a little goes a long way and it's been worth it for me.

[I received this product for free for my honest review] I used the product daily for last 2 weeks. I have dark spots on my face. I was using this in the morning and at night. It had significantly reduced the dark spots. My skin is glowing. I recommend to test it on your skin on a small patch first to see you are allergic to it or not. I find this profit very effective for me since it reduced the dark spot.

I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum and it's really nice if your skin leans dry or dull. You have to shake it because it's oil and serum mixed together, but once you do, it feels lightweight and gives a really pretty glow. It hydrates well without feeling greasy and makes my skin look more alive. Only thing is it has fragrance, so just something to be aware of. Overall, it's a solid glow serum that feels a little luxe without being heavy.
Dual texture serum that you have to shake before using, personally not a big fan. I found the texture too watery for my liking. I did not notice visible results despite using it for several weeks

I didn't expect to love this as much as I do, but it's become a staple. The formula feels lightweight but still super nourishing, and my skin looks noticeably more glowy and healthy after using it. It gives that hydrated, lit from within look without feeling greasy. Perfect under makeup. Gifted in exchange for my honest opinion.

avis.titre: Not too revitalizing, but still good product!
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum for a bit now, and overall I think it's a nice product with a few things worth mentioning. First, the packaging is really beautiful. The bottle feels high-end and looks great on my skincare shelf. It also has a light, pleasant scent that makes it feel a little luxurious when applying it. This serum has a double-layer formula, so you definitely need to shake the bottle well before using it. I usually apply it after washing my face. I shake it a few times, pour a small amount into my hands, and then press it into my skin almost like a toner rather than rubbing it in. One thing I really like is how quickly it absorbs. It dries down very fast and doesn't leave any heavy or greasy feeling on the skin. That makes it really easy to layer with other skincare products afterward. That said, I didn't notice a significant "glow" effect as the product description suggests. My skin is already pretty clear and balanced, and compared to some of the products I normally use (especially my COSRX skincare products), this one didn't feel quite as hydrating or serum-like to me. The texture almost sits somewhere between a toner and a lightweight serum. Overall, it's a nice, lightweight product that feels refreshing and absorbs quickly, but it didn't stand out dramatically in terms of results for my skin.

After using it consistently, I noticed my skin felt softer, smoother, and more refreshed. It works especially well when my skin feels dull or dehydrated. The subtle scent is pleasant but not overpowering, which makes the overall experience feel a bit more luxurious.

Korean skincare products are definitely making a splash in my skincare routine! I recently tried D'Alba Piedmont DOUBLE LAYER REVITALIZING SERUM, and it's a game-changer. avis.titre: Luxurious Glow with a Lightweight Feel
avis.texte: I've really enjoyed using the d'Alba White Truffle Double Layer Revitalizing Serum. The first thing I noticed is the unique double-layer formula—you shake the bottle before applying so the oil and serum blend together. It feels very lightweight on the skin but still gives a noticeable boost of hydration and radiance. The texture absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, which makes it great for both morning and evening routines. My skin tends to get dull and dehydrated, and this serum helped give it a healthier, more refreshed glow. I also love that it layers well under moisturizer and makeup without pilling. Another highlight is the subtle, elegant scent. It feels very spa-like and makes the application feel a bit more luxurious. After consistent use, my skin looked smoother and more balanced, and it seemed to help with overall brightness. Tips for best results: • Shake the bottle well before each use to fully mix the oil and serum layers. • Apply on slightly damp skin so it locks in more hydration. • Use 2–3 pumps and gently press it into your skin instead of rubbing. • Follow with a moisturizer to seal in the glow. • It also works beautifully as a prep step before makeup for a dewy finish. Overall, this is a lovely serum if you're looking for hydration, glow, and a lightweight formula that feels luxurious without being heavy.
